input: When I run the PDF register extraction pipeline on a 400-page SoC TRM, the bit-field boundaries for multi-row register tables come out misaligned — the MSB/LSB columns from row 2 onward get merged into the previous register's description column. The PDF was scanned rather than digitally authored. What preprocessing steps and heuristics should I apply before passing the table to the extractor to recover correct bit-field alignment?
